subject: chasme count
fact: Fist-sized chunks of quartz crystals erupted from the wall, shedding a dim ten-foot radiance.
source_quote: Fist-sized chunks of quartz crystals erupted from the wall, shedding a dim ten-foot radiance

subject: shrieker count
fact: Shriekers. The kind of noise that sends a jolt of adrenaline through any sane creature, screaming 'danger!' and 'dinner is served!' to anything else that might be lurking in the tunnels.
source_quote: Shriekers. The kind of noise that sends a jolt of adrenaline through any sane creature, screaming 'danger!' and 'dinner is served!'

subject: spectre count
fact: Four Spectres now hover, incorporeal and menacing.
source_quote: Four Spectres now hover, incorporeal and menacing

subject: wraith appearance
fact: A Wraith. Its voice, resonant with ancient menace, fills our minds, not with the pleas of the previous Spectres, but with a chilling declaration: 'Your deaths will free me from this prison, and how my victims will serve me even in death!'
source_quote: A Wraith. Its voice, resonant with ancient menace, fills our minds, not with the pleas of the previous Spectres, but with a chilling declaration: 'Your deaths will free me from this prison, and how my victims will serve me even in death!'

subject: travel to the Lost Tomb of Khaem
fact: We arrive at a large double door. The stone is ancient, hinting at a lost era, a common theme in this alien landscape.
source_quote: We arrive at a large double door. The stone is ancient, hinting at a lost era, a common theme in this alien landscape.

subject: discovery of hidden passage
fact: The northeast sarcophagus rests on hidden stone rollers. A possible secret, a hidden passage. This is it.
source_quote: The northeast sarcophagus rests on hidden stone rollers. A possible secret, a hidden passage. This is it.

subject: Velkynvelve elevation
fact: The Drow outpost was 100' in the sky.
source_quote: Drow outpost was 100' in the sky

subject: Underdark terrain
fact: The air grew heavy with the subtle, earthy scent of the damp loam and something indescribably sweeter.
source_quote: The air grew heavy with the subtle, earthy scent of the damp loam and something indescribably sweeter.

subject: Faerzress cave
fact: The air grew thick with a familiar, subtle hum, the Faerzress.
source_quote: The air grew thick with a familiar, subtle hum, the Faerzress.

subject: silver candlestick value
fact: The silver candlesticks flanking the Lolth altar are worth 25 gp each.
source_quote: a pair of heavy silver candlesticks worth 25 gp each

subject: quartz crystal value
fact: They are worth a great deal as gold, and perhaps even more to the right collector.
source_quote: They are worth a great deal as gold, and perhaps even more to the right collector.

subject: Netherese Calendar Stone
fact: A Netherese Calendar Stone, a relic of a time long gone, its purpose unclear.
source_quote: A Netherese Calendar Stone, a relic of a time long gone, its purpose unclear.

subject: invisible stone chest
fact: I notice the subtle shimmer of an invisible stone chest near its foot.
source_quote: I notice the subtle shimmer of an invisible stone chest near its foot.

subject: crystal weapon
fact: He holds a crystal as a weapon. It’s too pathetic.
source_quote: He holds a crystal as a weapon. It’s too pathetic.

subject: bet on crystal utility
fact: Jimjar shouts, 'Want to make a bet?' And so I turn to him, 'Wanna bet that these crystals will be useful?'
source_quote: Jimjar shouts, 'Want to make a bet?' And so I turn to him, 'Wanna bet that these crystals will be useful?'

subject: plea from trapped voice
fact: A soft, feminine voice, distant yet clear, rings out in my mind, 'Hello? Is someone there? Oh, please, I need your help! I have been trapped in the dark for so long... so very long. Please, won't you help me? Won't your help to free me?'
source_quote: A soft, feminine voice, distant yet clear, rings out in my mind, 'Hello? Is someone there? Oh, please, I need your help! I have been trapped in the dark for so long... so very long. Please, won't you help me? Won't your help to free me?'

subject: arrival at tomb entrance
fact: Sarith nods yes, this is the way. Of course, it does. Nothing in the Underdark is ever truly straightforward, yet here, a trapped voice leads us exactly where we intended to go, The Lost Tomb of Khaem.
source_quote: Sarith nods yes, this is the way. Of course, it does. Nothing in the Underdark is ever truly straightforward, yet here, a trapped voice leads us exactly where we intended to go, The Lost Tomb of Khaem.

subject: Netherese tomb interior
fact: Inside, a chill descends, and my eyes adjust to a faded grandeur. A stone diorama stands to the right, depicting a Netherese noble, Brysis of Khaem, surrounded by her retinue, flaunting wealth and power. To the left, a sprawling mural covers the wall, illustrating fantastic floating cities.
source_quote: Inside, a chill descends, and my eyes adjust to a faded grandeur. A stone diorama stands to the right, depicting a Netherese noble, Brysis of Khaem, surrounded by her retinue, flaunting wealth and power. To the left, a sprawling mural covers the wall, illustrating fantastic floating cities.

subject: shrine chamber
fact: The stairs finally give way to a shrine, its floor littered with shreds of dusty tapestries.
source_quote: The stairs finally give way to a shrine, its floor littered with shreds of dusty tapestries.

subject: final chamber
fact: We enter a new chamber, and the faint light catches murals on the walls, depicting grand scenes, probably of the Netherese sorceress Brysis of Khaem and her lost cities. A gilded sarcophagus gleams against one wall, clearly the focal point, and I notice the subtle shimmer of an invisible stone chest near its foot.
source_quote: We enter a new chamber, and the faint light catches murals on the walls, depicting grand scenes, probably of the Netherese sorceress Brysis of Khaem and her lost cities. A gilded sarcophagus gleams against one wall, clearly the focal point, and I notice the subtle shimmer of an invisible stone chest near its foot.

subject: long rest consideration
fact: I inquire, hopefully, 'Is this, would this be a good time for us to take a… Long rest. By chance?'
source_quote: I inquire, hopefully, 'Is this, would this be a good time for us to take a… Long rest. By chance?'

subject: opening sarcophagi
fact: Before we go down the dark passageway, we open the sarcophagi. Each sarcophagus contains mummified remains, the tattered remnants of ancient burial garments, and treasure of Netherese origin.
source_quote: Before we go down the dark passageway, we open the sarcophagi. Each sarcophagus contains mummified remains, the tattered remnants of ancient burial garments, and treasure of Netherese origin.

source_quote: They are worth a great deal as gold, and perhaps even more to the right collector.

subject: smashing crystals to hide tracks
fact: To hide our tracks, we smash the cavern and the crystals, as if some monster had attacked, not escaped slaves who took crystals that shone in the darkness.
source_quote: To hide our tracks, we smash the cavern and the crystals, as if some monster had attacked, not escaped slaves who took crystals that shone in the darkness.

source_quote: Magic Missile. Two bolts streak through the darkness, finding their mark on one Spectre. Another bolt follows, striking a second Spectre.

subject: spectre attack
fact: One Spectre lunges at me, its chilling form passing through my defenses. A jolt of cold, raw energy courses through me, necrotic damage, and I feel my very life force diminish.
source_quote: One Spectre lunges at me, its chilling form passing through my defenses. A jolt of cold, raw energy courses through me, necrotic damage, and I feel my very life force diminish.

fact: He kills one, then another. 'I will punch the ghost!' he declares.

fact: I stare at them and quickly surmise they are escapees from the Drow.

subject: escapee origin
fact: He explains that his name is Fuurm Coppernose, or Copper to his friends, who had lost his sister and went looking for her in the Underdark.
source_quote: He explains that his name is Fuurm Coppernose, or Copper to his friends, who had lost his sister and went looking for her in the Underdark.

subject: escapee survival
fact: Baedora explains, 'That it was demons that attacked. The Drow fought back. We ran. Figured we were more likely to stay alive away from Drow and Demons.'
source_quote: Baedora explains, 'That it was demons that attacked. The Drow fought back. We ran. Figured we were more likely to stay alive away from Drow and Demons.'

subject: invitation to join
fact: And so I invite them to join our group.
source_quote: And so I invite them to join our group.

subject: Underdark fungal forest
fact: There were the towering stalks and caps of fungi, a veritable forest of the subterranean. Mushrooms of all kinds and of all types, stretching up into the unseen ceiling, some glowing faintly with a soft, bioluminescent light, others a muted, earthy brown.
source_quote: There were the towering stalks and caps of fungi, a veritable forest of the subterranean. Mushrooms of all kinds and of all types, stretching up into the unseen ceiling, some glowing faintly with a soft, bioluminescent light, others a muted, earthy brown.

subject: crystal collection
fact: We have collected so many strays that one more won’t harm us.
source_quote: We have collected so many strays that one more won’t harm us.

subject: crystal collection
fact: Before we leave the cave, we take as many crystals as we can.
source_quote: Before we leave the cave, we take as many crystals as we can.

subject: drow origin
fact: My whole life, I was a Drow of Menzoberranzan. Trapped in the formalities of ritual and expectations, trying to avoid the predations of the Cult of Lolth and the machinations of the Noble Houses.
source_quote: My whole life, I was a Drow of Menzoberranzan. Trapped in the formalities of ritual and expectations, trying to avoid the predations of the Cult of Lolth and the machinations of the Noble Houses.

subject: underdark realization
fact: I never saw the Underdark for what it is, a place to explore and learn. And now I know this journey not as an escape to another place, but instead as an escape from a previous worldview.
source_quote: I never saw the Underdark for what it is, a place to explore and learn. And now I know this journey not as an escape to another place, but instead as an escape from a previous worldview.

subject: eldeth's track hiding
fact: For two days, Eldeth has been hiding our tracks for two days, where all we could see when we could see was the dark passages.
source_quote: For two days, Eldeth has been hiding our tracks for two days, where all we could see when we could see was the dark passages.

subject: sarith's confidence
fact: Sarith insisted he knew where we were going.
source_quote: Sarith insisted he knew where we were going.

fact: Zalthir, who is curiously unobservant, scoughs.
source_quote: Zalthir, who is curiously unobservant, scoughs.

subject: grygum's memory
fact: He then recalls old tales of 'floating undead creatures that typically rest in tombs'.

subject: fargas' warning

subject: daz's necrotic damage
fact: A jolt of cold, raw energy courses through me, necrotic damage, and I feel my very life force diminish. Before I can fully process it, another Spectre attacks, a more potent drain this time, twice as much necrotic damage, and my strength wanes further.
source_quote: A jolt of cold, raw energy courses through me, necrotic damage, and I feel my very life force diminish. Before I can fully process it, another Spectre attacks, a more potent drain this time, twice as much necrotic damage, and my strength wanes further.

subject: daz's long rest plea
fact: 'I'm gonna need a long rest here pretty soon,' I mutter, the words barely audible, a desperate plea for recovery.
source_quote: 'I'm gonna need a long rest here pretty soon,' I mutter, the words barely audible, a desperate plea for recovery.

subject: grygum's turn undead attempt
fact: Grygum, in his devotion, tries to turn them, his holy symbol raised, but the Spectres resist, their wills too strong, or perhaps their existence too ancient to be swayed.
source_quote: Grygum, in his devotion, tries to turn them, his holy symbol raised, but the Spectres resist, their wills too strong, or perhaps their existence too ancient to be swayed.

subject: zalthir's shadow sphere
fact: I move into position, my hands forming the familiar gestures. I call forth the shadows, plunging the area around the sarcophagus into a sphere of magical darkness.
source_quote: I move into position, my hands forming the familiar gestures. I call forth the shadows, plunging the area around the sarcophagus into a sphere of magical darkness.

subject: thorin's push
fact: Thorin, strong as an ox, leverages the darkness, pushing the heavy sarcophagus aside.
source_quote: Thorin, strong as an ox, leverages the darkness, pushing the heavy sarcophagus aside.

subject: chill and moan
fact: A chill emanates from everywhere at once. Rime creeps across surfaces, and my breath plumes before me in the suddenly frigid air. A moan, pained and distant, rises with the wind.
source_quote: A chill emanates from everywhere at once. Rime creeps across surfaces, and my breath plumes before me in the suddenly frigid air. A moan, pained and distant, rises with the wind.

subject: spectre emergence
fact: From the newly opened space, a form coalesces from the gloom – translucent, malevolent, undeniably undead. A Spectre.
source_quote: From the newly opened space, a form coalesces from the gloom – translucent, malevolent, undeniably undead. A Spectre.
